main_body: multi-story brick campus building with green roof
top_band: grey parapet and green copper/tile roof surface from row 1 to row 40
evidence: The building shows a deep 40px top roof surface (rows 1-40) with parapet walls, inner shadow at the back (rows 4-5), textured green roof deck (rows 6-37), and front parapet rim (rows 38-40). Below this is a cornice and a 3-story brick front facade (rows 41-143) with eave shadows under ledges and recessed windows/doors.

style.evidence: While the 3/4 geometry is solid, the art style is much more mechanical, repetitive, and geometric compared to the organic, richly shaded Beodeul reference buildings. The brick wall uses a rigid repeating 2-3 colour grid without per-brick highlight variation or weathering, the 28 windows are identical copy-pasted stamps, and the green roof uses a simple repeating tile pattern lacking the rich 5-6 step value ramps of the reference roofs.
